notes.title: Elo Hell Split DLC Update
notes.content:
Hey! Good news and bad news, everyone.

Bad news is that Elo Hell is not selling as well as expected. We are having a visibility issue. The people we can get to play the game are enjoying it, but we aren't getting enough people downloading the game to even begin understanding where we sit in this space. Personally, I think we're just too niche. I truly believe our game is awesome and one-of-a-kind, but it's very different and we need time to find our audience.

Because of this slowness, we have to slow down Elo Hell's release schedule and wait for people to discover it. Episodes 6-10 are on an indefinite hiatus until we can hit sales goals.

Good news is Elo Hell is not dead and we will be releasing episodes 1-5 this month. Episode 1 will remain free and episodes 2-5 will cost $15. Episodes 6-10 will not come out until we can afford to come back to it, but every sale made is going into a piggy bank to be used for if/when that time comes. All existing season pass owners will have the option to refund the game no matter how far you are.

So please know that coming into this, you can access what we have for $15 and that is contributing to the future of Elo Hell. Episodes 3-5 will have some minor rough edges compared to 1 and 2, but they will still be very strong. If we hit our goals, those episodes will get their final polish pass.

In the meantime, we'll be working on other, smaller projects. We may or may not return to Guncraft. We'll see ;).

We are 100% commited to Elo Hell. It's our baby, the product of 4.5 years of work, and a huge passion project, but at the same time, we need to see some interest in the game or else we are just burning money. This is a business at the end of the day and we have lots of bills to pay.

So if you want to see Elo Hell come back, please use the hashtag [b]#SaveEloHell [/b]to spread the word. It'll be a slow return, but I'm optimistic that given enough time, we'll find our home.

GLHF,

John "Darknuke" Getty
Executive Producer
Exato Games

notes.title: Elo Hell Sitcom Trailer, Massive Game Update, & Launch Date!
notes.content:
[b]ELO HELL LAUNCHES JULY 30TH! THAT'S NEXT TUESDAY![/b] We also did a massive pre-launch update to the game.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fVlHHNBHTlU][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33220141/afed13db93c3e9a02d5c3a9f072d959943284990.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fVlHHNBHTlU][b][h1]"Stuck in Elo Hell" Sitcom Intro Launch Trailer[/h1][/b][/url]
Every good sitcom has a catchy intro, so we made one too! We guarantee you'll love it and it'll get you hyped for launch :D.

[u][b]We launch July 30th[/b][/u], when we'll be increasing the cost of the game from [b]$20 -> $30[/b], so be sure to utilize the discount while you can.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33220141/fa1447963a15b93913d48ddfe814238618a1323d.png[/img]

Echo Star is finally ready to be released into the wild! It is an RTS-inspired, turn-based strategy game. We've taken the essence of games like Starcraft and Age of Empires and turn-based it to reduce stress and increase accessibility for us plebs who can't mash a keyboard at 300 actions per minute.

We've just released our final test build (work out the last remaining kinks), complete with an entertaining, meta-breaking tutorial, on Early Access RIGHT NOW!

notes.title: Con Season 2019 & Updates
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33220141/62fa43883628b31c1366faf018bc668873530449.png[/img]

Elo Hell is on tour! Come check us out at these three upcoming conventions to see our premiere first episode in action. And yes, that is TwitchCon BERLIN! We're coming for you, Germany!

Episode 1: Butts in Chairs is a goofy episode about chair culture in esports with multiple minigames and potential endings. It will go live on Early Access PAX East weekend!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33220141/01a3a3d4fb68781828f0d5e38f6cb5632256623f.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW EPISODES![/h1]

Episode 2: An Otter Day an Otter Dollar is near completion! The gang goes to the fair and fun games, rides, shenanigans, and surprises are in store for them along the way.

 
This episode is very nearly complete and will only see a short release into Early Access before being pulled to get ready for our real launch this summer. If you're interested in trying it, stay tuned to these newsletters to get more info.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33220141/77707da6fa5268602658e842fd5c441a6fb05a6a.png[/img]

[h1]MACHINE LEARNING[/h1]

We've been hard at work on Echo Star and part of that work has been practicing our skills in machine learning. We've currently made an Asteroids game as well as Tetris. We'll be posting videos about how that goes to our YouTube channel, so be sure to [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/ExatoGameStudios]subscribe[/url] to our YouTube!
